Chapter 490 - 490 Thank You; Set Questions!

Chapter 490 - 490 Thank You; Set Questions!

490 Thank You; Set Questions!

“Thank you, Professor Lin!” Hao Zhiwu said seriously.

From his point of view, Lin Fan had put down his name as the second author because he wanted to take care of him.

Riemann’s Hypothesis was too important.

Even as a second author, it would still bring great benefits to him in the future.

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, and Jiang Chaoqun also said, “Thank you, Professor Lin.

Lin Fan waved his hand casually and did not explain further. “Are there any unsolvable problems recently?”

Hao Zhiwu quickly took out a few pieces of draft paper.

…

Lin Fan first spent about an hour answering and explaining all the problems that they had encountered.

Then, he lay on the executive chair and leisurely played with his phone.

At this moment, there was the sound of brisk footsteps outside.

Shen Liang, the chancellor of Jiangbei University, and two middle-aged men in white shirts walked in slowly.

“Professor Lin, so you came to the office today?” Shen Liang smiled. “That’s great.”

“Yes, I did.” Lin Fan touched his nose and said, “Chancellor Shen, why are you here?”

Not coming to school often made Lin Fan feel a little embarrassed.

“Oh, these two are Director Liu and Director Huang from the Education Research Institute. They have something to say to you,” Shen Liang said.

“Professor Lin, I’ve heard a lot about you.”

“Hello, Professor Lin.”

…

The two directors greeted Lin Fan and extended their right hands to him.

Lin Fan also extended his hand and greeted them.

At this time, Director Liu said, “Mr. Lin, if it’s convenient, can we find a place to talk?”

Lin Fan did not mind and said, “Sure.”

Lin Fan, Shen Liang, and the two directors left the office.

“Professor Lin is awesome!” Hao Zhiwu exclaimed sincerely.

It was no wonder that he would sigh like this.

One had to know…

Shen Liang was the chancellor of Jiangbei University!

He had always been the only one who people reported things to.

When had they ever seen him personally come looking for someone?

In addition, the Education Research Institute was an incredible institution. Now, two directors had appeared!

…

Not long after, Lin Fan and the two directors arrived at the meeting room.

Shen Liang understood that these two directors probably had something to discuss with Lin Fan.

Therefore, he found an excuse and left first.

“Professor Lin, first of all, congratulations on solving Riemann’s Hypothesis.”

“It’s just solving a problem. Director Liu, you’re too polite.”

Director Liu was stunned for a moment. It was just a problem?

However, this was Riemann’s Hypothesis!

Perhaps, in this entire world, only Lin Fan could make this matter sound so light.

Director Liu coughed dryly and said, “Although you just solved a problem, it’s a difficult problem that has troubled the world for nearly a hundred years…”

Lin Fan saw that he wanted to continue lamenting and interrupted, “Director Liu, why did you come to look for me?”

All along, Lin Fan did not like to listen to too much nonsense. It was too boring.

Director Liu seemed to have noticed this and continued, “The college entrance examination is about to be held. I wonder if you can help me come up with the final question for each of these four subjects—mathematics, physics, biology, and chemistry?”

When Lin Fan heard this, he was slightly stunned.

When he was in high school, the exam that he looked forward to the most was the college entrance examination.

Later, because her sister was seriously ill, he chose to give up on it.

He was now asked to set the college entrance examination questions?

He could not take the college entrance examination back then, and now, he was the one preparing the questions for others?

This… It seemed like a pretty good thing!

Director Liu saw that Lin Fan did not reply and could not help but say, “I know that this might be a little too much for you, but if you do this, many high school students in Hua Nation will be very happy.

“Because many students look up to you as their role model!”

Lin Fan smiled and said, “Director Liu, you’ve misunderstood. I’m very happy to set the questions for the college entrance examination.”

When Director Liu and Director Huang heard this, they both revealed a hint of joy.

“Really? This is great!”

“Thank you, Professor Lin.”

…

Director Liu did not forget to remind him, “Since the college entrance examination is on June 7th, and we still need time to print the test papers…

“Professor Lin, if it’s possible, please prepare the questions before May 25th.”

Lin Fan waved his hand and said, “It won’t take that long. Did you bring a pen and paper?”

“Huh?” Director Liu was stunned for a moment and said, “Yes.”

As he spoke, he handed over a pen and paper.

Lin Fan asked, “Do you have any requirements for the four final questions?”

Director Liu thought for a moment and said, “I don’t have any specific requirements… As long as they can test the students’ learning of the subject in the three years of high school, that’ll be enough.”

Lin Fan nodded thoughtfully. After thinking for about ten seconds, he picked up the ballpoint pen and started writing quickly on the paper.

After a while, the four questions appeared.

“These…” Director Liu was puzzled.

“Didn’t you just ask me to prepare the questions for the college entrance examination? Here,” Lin Fan said.

“Huh… So fast?” Director Liu stuttered.

After all, this was the college entrance examination they were talking about.

It was a major exam that involved the fate of millions of students!

It could also be said that… to be the most important exam in Hua Nation!

Lin Fan wrote down the questions just like that?

From the time he said he was going to set the college entrance examination questions to the time he wrote them, and there were a total of four questions, had it been a total of three minutes?

“It’s just a few questions for high school students,” Lin Fan said casually. “I don’t have to think about it for too long.”

Director Liu opened his mouth and looked at the questions in his hand. He then said helplessly, “Alright…Alright then. Although these questions might not necessarily appear on the college entrance examination papers.

“But Professor Lin, please keep this matter and these questions a secret.”

In fact, if it was someone else who set the questions, it would definitely not be as simple as asking for confidentiality.

It would require going through a strict process.

However, Lin Fan was the one who invented the earthquake prediction device, the carbon-based photolithographic machine, the super battery, and the human islet recovery drug… He had different privileges.

Lin Fan said, “Don’t worry, I know the rules.”

“Is there anything else?” Lin Fan asked.

“No,” Director Liu thought for a moment and said.

Hence, Lin Fan got up and prepared to leave.

At this moment, Director Liu could not help but call out to him again. “Professor Lin, do you want to prepare a few more questions as backup?”

Lin Fan waved his hand and said, “There’s no need. These questions are quite suitable.”

After saying that, he walked forward without looking back.

Director Liu and Director Huang looked at each other and sighed.

…

As for the matter of the college entrance exam, Lin Fan was only a little happy when he first found out.

After that, he put the matter aside.

He had just turned into the corridor when he saw Shen Liang standing in front of him, overlooking the campus scenery below. He casually greeted him, “Chancellor, are you admiring the scenery?”

When Shen Liang heard this, he slowly turned around and said, “Yes… Yes, Professor Lin, you finished chatting with Director Liu and Director Huang so quickly?”

“Yes, we just exchanged a few words,” Lin Fan said.
